name: 25I-NBMD
summary: A psychedelic phenethylamine that is related to the 25X-NBOMe series. The drug is highly potent.
advisory: Avoid: Other psychedelics, stimulants, and redosing

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent partial agonist for the 5HT2A receptor with a Ki of 0.049 nM at the human 5HT2A receptor. The corresponding 4-bromo analogue 25B-NBMD has been used for molecular dynamics studies on the shape of the 5-HT2A receptor.
